candidates.title: Lorry collides with RTC bus in Hyderabad, 12 injured
candidates.excerpt: Hyderabad: As many as 12 people were injured after a lorry collided with a Telangana State Road Transport Corporation (TGSRTC) bus on Tuesday, September 15, near Kuntloor Rajiv Gruhakalp. The lorry hit the bus on the side, shattering windows. A video of the incident shows pieces of glass strewn across the seats and the floor. …

candidates.title: 59-year-old man found murdered in Telangana’s Vikarabad
candidates.excerpt: Hyderabad: A 59-year-old man was found murdered at his residence in Telangana’s Vikarabad on Monday, September 14. Police identified the victim as Vadde Bujjappa, a resident of Yanki village in Doulatabad mandal. Unidentified assailants reportedly murdered Bujjappa, the police said, with the murder coming to light when a neighbour came to the victim’s residence to …

candidates.title: MBA student dies of electrocution at Ganesh pandal in Hyderabad
candidates.excerpt: A 22-year-old MBA first-year student, identified as Arya, died of electrocution at a Ganesh pandal at a private hostel of ICFAI University on Monday night. He reportedly came into contact with a live electric wire near the mandapam.

candidates.title: ‘Telangana Police working for Congress’, says KTR
candidates.excerpt: Hyderabad: Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) Working President KT Rama Rao on Tuesday, September 15 alleged that the Telangana police was working more actively for the Congress party than even its own workers. candidates.title: CM Revanth Reddy Meets Prince Rahim Aga Khan V, Seeks Support for Hyderabad Heritage and Musi Rejuvenation
candidates.excerpt: Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy met Prince Rahim Aga Khan V at the historic Taj Falaknuma Palace in Hyderabad and sought support from the Aga Khan Foundation for the preservation of Hyderabad’s heritage and the rejuvenation of the Musi River.

candidates.title: Former Andhra Pradesh Deputy CM Alla Nani dies of cardiac arrest at 56
candidates.excerpt: The Eluru leader was Health Minister through the pandemic in the Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy government, lost his seat in 2024, quit the YSRCP that August and joined the TDP in February 2025

candidates.title: Study on Keralam ELSA-3 shipwreck shows persistent nurdle pollution, evolving ecological impacts
candidates.excerpt: In the aftermath of the May 2025 accident, the Tamil Nadu Pollution Control Board (TNPCB) initiated short term (rapid) and long term (two years) impact assessment studies through Suganthi Devadason Marine Research Institute (SDMRI) in Thoothukudi.

candidates.title: Supreme Court Dismisses Telangana Government Plea in Shanta Shriram Constructions Land Dispute
candidates.excerpt: In a setback to the Telangana government and HYDRA, the Supreme Court has dismissed a petition filed by the Congress-led state government in connection with an ongoing land dispute involving Shanta Shriram Constructions.

candidates.title: Keralam social worker Mavoorus Maliyekkal dies
Young doctor dies by suicide in Karimnagar
candidates.excerpt: Young doctor and public health advocate Dr Gautam Pasula died by suicide in Karimnagar on Monday. Family members and colleagues said he had been distressed after two unsuccessful postgraduate medical entrance attempts. HRDA Telangana mourned his death and recalled his healthcare advocacy.
